method.pricing: sum of known settled costs only; unknown cost is not free
method.historicalGeminiCaveat: Before Step 6 Gemini thought-token accounting correction, output counters could omit thought tokens; original SDK total tokens are retained in each raw response
method.upstreamLatency: Actual adapter wall time; distinct from admission-to-terminal case latency.
